query:
insert into RequirementsWithSatisfyTraces (
                product_id,
                req_id,
                file_hash,
                trace_line
            )
            select distinct rt.product_id, rt.req_id, t.file_hash, t.line
            from Traces t, DirectProductReqTraces rt
            where rt.file_hash = t.file_hash
            and rt.line = t.line
            and t.kind = $1
